overview: A mobile-first Gen AI teaching platform for students and professionals. Features a full course catalog, rich lesson content, quizzes with instant feedback, student progress tracking, and an admin panel to manage all curriculum content. Comes pre-loaded with sample Gen AI courses covering Prompt Engineering, Ethical AI, and GenAI Fundamentals.
features: Course catalog with difficulty levels and lesson counts
Rich lesson viewer with code examples and Gen AI content
Multiple-choice quizzes with instant feedback and explanations
Student dashboard with progress tracking and resume feature
Admin panel to create and manage courses, lessons, and quizzes
Pre-loaded Gen AI curriculum (3 courses, 10+ lessons, 9+ quizzes)
